parsed.why: No anti-trans law and hate-crime protections with police gender-identity guidelines, but documented impunity, disregarded complaints and a strongly heteronormative society; trans-specific violence is dated (2009-2014) and prevalence data is old and LGBT-wide.

New military-enacted statute jails same-sex conduct 2-5 years, bans 'promotion', and states foreigners will be deported; no anti-discrimination law, no recognition, no recourse, hostile society, military rule. Unenforced so far, but thin record extrapolates to risk.

No gender-expression offence and courts have ruled for trans recognition, but current ground-level reporting documents frequent harassment of visibly trans people in public and government spaces plus rising official-adjacent anti-LGBT rhetoric and threats.

Court struck down sodomy laws and read sex discrimination to cover gender identity; no documented trans-specific targeting or violence, but no statutory protections, no document remedy, and no violence or police-practice data either way.

No criminalisation since 1791, yet no anti-discrimination or hate-crime law, judiciary no protection avenue, officially assessed hostility to visible LGBT people, an unresolved 2019 killing of an advocacy leader, and dated pending advocacy-ban bills.
